subject.title: Feature: groupScope option to consolidate group sessions into main

question: Should OpenClaw accept a groupScope-style core config for folding selected group/channel peers into the agent main session, and what audit/docs/proof gate is required before the linked PR can land?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested config changes a transcript trust boundary and adds core session-routing surface, which needs maintainer product/security intent rather than another autonomous fix PR.

options.title: Land after security and parity gates
options.body: Proceed with the linked groupScope direction only after the PR is refreshed, real behavior proof is attached, inbound/outbound session behavior is parity-supported, and audit/docs warning posture is settled.

options.title: Narrow to binding-only or named sessions
options.body: Reject a global group-to-main default for now and sponsor a narrower per-binding or named shared-session design that limits accidental trust-boundary collapse.

options.title: Defer to the broader shared-session design
options.body: Keep this request open only as context for the broader shared-session work if maintainers decide the focused groupScope surface should not land independently.

recommendation.title: Land after security and parity gates
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked groupScope direction only after the PR is refreshed, real behavior proof is attached, inbound/outbound session behavior is parity-supported, and audit/docs warning posture is settled.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest visible history across routing, docs, and security-audit boundaries relevant to the decision.
